cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Make Them Your Deputy
cards.instruction: Get someone’s help by defining it as service under your direction.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. I need help running the raffle. I've made you a deputy badge. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Because I need help, not a second direction.
